title: Two Claude models built the same mine cart game in Godot
author: orellanaed
selftext:
Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, same prompt, each in Claude Code with an MCP server that let it press Play, drive the cart and screenshot its own game. Every mesh built from code, no 3D models.

- Neither built a physics cart. Both ride a curve, so the weight comes from camera roll, FOV and sound.
- Sonnet playtested twice as much and still shipped a hole in the tunnel wall.
- Opus made the better game, but mixed its audio far too loud.

Video: https://youtu.be/BnNrlpuAUFI

Disclosure: I'm building Flockbay, the Godot app whose MCP they used.

Has anyone gotten an agent to build a real physics vehicle?
